dsr_requests_extension_check.name: dsr_requests_extension_check
dsr_requests_extension_check.value: ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_notice_at" IS NULL) OR ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IN (1, 2) AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."due_at" > "privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at")
